- name: Configure VLAN trunk sub-interfaces on node2/node3 and route via node1

        ifname: "vlan{{ vlan_id }}"
        vlandev: "{{ trunk_iface }}"
        vlanid: "{{ vlan_id }}"
        ip4: "{{ vlan_ip }}"
        gw4: "{{ router_vlan_ip }}"

      community.general.nmcli:
        type: vlan
        conn_name: "vlan{{ vlan_id }}"
        state: up

    - name: Check whether the route to the peer VLAN subnet is already configured
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: "nmcli -g ipv4.routes connection show vlan{{ vlan_id }}"
      register: existing_routes
      changed_when: false

    - name: Add explicit route to the peer VLAN subnet via node1
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: "nmcli connection modify vlan{{ vlan_id }} +ipv4.routes '{{ peer_net }} {{ router_vlan_ip }}'"
      when: peer_net not in existing_routes.stdout

    - name: Reapply the VLAN connection so the route takes effect
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: "nmcli connection up vlan{{ vlan_id }}"
      when: route_mod is changed

- name: Configure VyOS router node1 with VLAN sub-interfaces

        set interfaces ethernet eth1 vif 20 address "10.10.20.1/24"
